sources.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: QLoRA 's efficiency enables us to perform an in-depth study of instruction finetuning and chatbot performance on model scales that would be impossible using regular finetuning due to memory overhead. Therefore, we train more than 1,000 models across several instruction tuning datasets, model architectures, and sizes between 80M to 65B parameters.

sources.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs - GitHub
sources.snippet: QLoRA backpropagates gradients through a frozen, 4-bit quantized pretrained language model into Low Rank Adapters (LoRA). sources.title: Internalizing Tool Knowledge in Small Language Models via QLoRA Fine-Tuning
sources.snippet: Abstract—Tool-using language agents commonly include full tool schemas in every prompt, even when the available tools are fixed across many queries. This repeated schema context increases input length and can make small models unreliable planners. sources.title: Fine-Tuning a Tool-Calling Agent: SFT + QLoRA on Gemma 3 4B
sources.snippet: How I turned a prompt-driven ReAct agent over a 40+ tool MCP backend into a fine-tuned one — collecting multi-turn tool trajectories, building the SFT dataset, training Gemma 3 4B with QLoRA, and serving it back behind the agent loop. The case study that ties the whole fine-tuning series together.
